# CMA opens enquiry into Pilgrim’s acquisition of Samworth subsidiary
Walkers supplies premium sausages to UK supermarkets

The CMA has opened a phase 1 enquiry into Pilgrim’s acquisition of Walkers Deli & Sausage Co. from Samworth Brothers.
Pilgrim’s Pride Corporation, part of the Brazilian-owned JBS group, agreed to buy Walkers from Samworth Brothers in August 2026. Owned by Samworth since 1986, the business employs 1,150 staff, and supplies supermarkets with premium sausages, sliced cooked meats, cooked bacon snacks and pâté.
Pilgrim’s Europe president Ivan Siqueira said at the time of the deal that it represented an “important strategic step” for the group’s UK strategy.

“This acquisition is a natural strategic fit for Pilgrim’s Europe. We already have a well-established supply relationship with Walkers Deli & Sausage and see significant opportunities to build on the strengths of both businesses.
“By bringing Walkers Deli & Sausage into Pilgrim’s Europe, we will further strengthen our integrated supply chain, expand our presence in attractive premium pork categories and enhance our ability to serve customers across the UK. We are excited about the opportunities ahead and look forward to welcoming Walkers Deli & Sausage colleagues to the Pilgrim’s family following completion of the transaction.”

The acquisition represents an important strategic step for Pilgrim's Europe, strengthening its position within the UK food industry and expanding its presence in value-added premium pork categories. It also enhances Pilgrim's footprint in the UK and builds on an existing long-standing relationship between the two businesses.
Walkers Deli & Sausage has a highly complementary portfolio spanning premium sausages, sliced cooked meats, cooked bacon, snacking products, and pâté. The business serves leading UK retailers and is recognised for its expertise in premium own-label food production.
Ivan Siqueira, President of Pilgrim's Europe, said:
